perCase.question: What were the top 5 products by revenue?
perCase.sql:
SELECT p.name AS product_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total)::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM order_items oi
JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'delivered')
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

perCase.question: What were the top 5 product categories by revenue last month?
perCase.sql:
SELECT pc.name AS category_name, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total)::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN product_categories pc ON p.category_id = pc.category_id
WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'delivered')
  AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month'
  AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
GROUP BY pc.name
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 5

perCase.question: Which cities generated the most revenue?
perCase.sql:
SELECT ca.city AS city, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total)::numeric, 2) AS revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN customer_addresses ca ON o.shipping_address_id = ca.address_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'delivered')
GROUP BY ca.city
ORDER BY revenue DESC
LIMIT 10

perCase.question: What was the average order value last month?
perCase.sql:
SELECT ROUND(AVG(orders.total_amount)::numeric, 2) AS avg_order_value
FROM orders
WHERE status IN ('shipped', 'delivered')
  AND order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month'
  AND order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)

perCase.question: Which category had the highest growth in revenue last month compared to the month before?
perCase.sql:
WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT pc.name AS category,
         SUM(oi.line_total) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month'
                                      AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
                                      AND o.status IN ('shipped','delivered')) AS rev_last,
         SUM(oi.line_total) FILTER (WHERE o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '2 month'
                                      AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month'
                                      AND o.status IN ('shipped','delivered')) AS rev_prev
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
  JOIN product_categories pc ON pc.category_id = p.category_id
  GROUP BY pc.name
)
SELECT category,
       ROUND((rev_last - rev_prev) / NULLIF(rev_prev,0) * 100, 2) AS growth_percent
FROM revenue
WHERE rev_prev <> 0
ORDER BY growth_percent DESC
LIMIT 1

perCase.question: How many customers made more than 3 purchases?
perCase.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customers_with_more_than_3_purchases FROM (
  SELECT o.customer_id
  FROM orders AS o
  WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'delivered')
  GROUP BY o.customer_id
  HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) > 3
) AS sub

perCase.question: Which products have low inventory?
perCase.sql:
SELECT p.product_id, p.name AS product_name, SUM(wi.quantity_on_hand) AS total_quantity_on_hand, MIN(wi.reorder_level) AS reorder_level
FROM warehouse_inventory wi
JOIN products p ON wi.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
HAVING SUM(wi.quantity_on_hand) <= MIN(wi.reorder_level)
ORDER BY total_quantity_on_hand ASC

perCase.question: Which supplier provides the most products?
perCase.sql:
SELECT s.supplier_id, s.name, COUNT(p.product_id) AS product_count
FROM suppliers s
JOIN products p ON p.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
GROUP BY s.supplier_id, s.name
ORDER BY product_count DESC
LIMIT 1

perCase.question: What is the monthly revenue trend for the last 6 months?
perCase.sql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '6 month',
    date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month',
    interval '1 month'
  ) AS month_start
),
rev AS (
  SELECT date_trunc('month', o.order_date) AS month_start,
         SUM(oi.line_total) AS revenue
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.status IN ('shipped','delivered')
    AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '6 month'
    AND o.order_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
  GROUP BY month_start
)
SELECT m.month_start,
       ROUND(COALESCE(r.revenue, 0), 2) AS revenue
FROM months m
LEFT JOIN rev r ON r.month_start = m.month_start
ORDER BY m.month_start

perCase.question: Which promotion generated the highest revenue?
perCase.sql:
SELECT p.promotion_id, p.code, p.name, ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total)::numeric, 2) AS promotion_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN promotions p ON o.promotion_id = p.promotion_id
WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'delivered')
  AND o.promotion_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY p.promotion_id, p.code, p.name
ORDER BY promotion_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

perCase.question: What percentage of orders were refunded?
perCase.sql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0), 2) AS refund_rate
FROM orders o
LEFT JOIN refunds r ON o.order_id = r.order_id
WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'delivered')

perCase.question: What was the total revenue last year?
perCase.sql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue
FROM orders o
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'delivered')
  AND o.order_date >= date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 year'
  AND o.order_date < date_trunc('year', CURRENT_DATE)

perCase.question: How many orders are there in each status?
perCase.sql: SELECT orders.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders GROUP BY orders.status ORDER BY order_count DESC

perCase.question: Who are the top 10 customers by total spend?
perCase.sql:
SELECT c.customer_id,
       c.first_name,
       c.last_name,
       c.segment,
       ROUND(SUM(o.total_amount)::numeric, 2) AS total_spend
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status IN ('shipped', 'delivered')
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.segment
ORDER BY total_spend DESC
LIMIT 10

perCase.question: What is the average review rating per product category?
perCase.sql:
SELECT pc.name AS category_name,
       ROUND(AVG(r.rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating,
       COUNT(*) AS review_count
  FROM reviews r
  JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN product_categories pc ON p.category_id = pc.category_id
 GROUP BY pc.name
 ORDER BY avg_rating DESC

perCase.question: Which 5 products have the highest average rating (at least 5 reviews)?
perCase.sql:
SELECT
  p.product_id,
  p.name,
  ROUND(AVG(r.rating)::numeric, 2) AS avg_rating,
  COUNT(*) AS review_count
FROM reviews r
JOIN products p ON r.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5
ORDER BY avg_rating DESC
LIMIT 5

perCase.question: Which payment method is used most often?
perCase.sql: SELECT payment_method, COUNT(*) AS count FROM payments GROUP BY payment_method ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 1

perCase.question: How many customers came from each acquisition channel?
Which store had the highest in-store sales over the last 12 months?
perCase.sql:
SELECT s.store_id, s.name, s.city, ROUND(SUM(ss.total_amount)::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN stores s ON ss.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE ss.sale_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '12 month'
  AND ss.sale_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)

perCase.question: Who are the top 5 employees by in-store sales amount?
perCase.sql:
SELECT e.employee_id, e.first_name, e.last_name, ROUND(SUM(ss.total_amount)::numeric, 2) AS total_sales_amount
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN employees e ON ss.employee_id = e.employee_id

perCase.question: Which warehouse ships the most orders?
perCase.sql:
SELECT w.name AS warehouse_name, COUNT(DISTINCT s.order_id) AS order_count
FROM warehouses w
JOIN shipping s ON s.warehouse_id = w.warehouse_id
GROUP BY w.name
ORDER BY order_count DESC
LIMIT 1

perCase.question: What is the average delivery time in days for each carrier?
perCase.sql:
SELECT carrier, ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (delivered_at - shipped_at)) / 86400), 2) AS avg_delivery_time_days
FROM shipping
WHERE delivered_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY carrier
ORDER BY avg_delivery_time_days DESC

perCase.question: What is the total revenue by country?

perCase.question: Which brand generates the most revenue?
perCase.sql:
WITH brand_revenue AS (
  SELECT pb.brand_id,
         pb.name AS brand_name,
         SUM(oi.line_total) AS total_revenue
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN product_brands pb ON p.brand_id = pb.brand_id
  WHERE o.status IN ('shipped','delivered')
  GROUP BY pb.brand_id, pb.name
)
SELECT brand_id,
       brand_name,
       ROUND(total_revenue::numeric, 2) AS total_revenue
FROM brand_revenue
ORDER BY total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 1

perCase.question: How many active products are there in each category?
How many new customers signed up per month over the last 6 months?
perCase.sql:
WITH month_series AS (
  SELECT generate_series(
    date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '6 months',
    date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '1 month',
    interval '1 month'
  ) AS month_start
)
SELECT
  ms.month_start,
  COALESCE(c.new_customers, 0) AS new_customers
FROM month_series ms
LEFT JOIN (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', cu.signup_date)::date AS month_start,
    COUNT(*) AS new_customers
  FROM customers cu
  WHERE cu.signup_date >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE) - interval '6 months'
    AND cu.signup_date < date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE)
  GROUP BY month_start
) c ON ms.month_start = c.month_start
ORDER BY ms.month_start

perCase.question: What is the gross profit by product category?
perCase.sql:
SELECT
  pc.name AS category_name,
  ROUND(SUM(oi.line_total - oi.quantity * p.unit_cost)::numeric, 2) AS gross_profit
FROM
  orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
  JOIN product_categories pc ON p.category_id = pc.category_id
WHERE
  o.status IN ('shipped', 'delivered')
GROUP BY
  pc.name
ORDER BY
  gross_profit DESC
